top_signals.title: US Stocks Drift as Fed Bets Face Inflation Test: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stocks struggled for direction ahead of inflation data that will cap a dramatic week in which traders ramped up bets on Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes and Jensen Huang was ousted from Nvidia Corp.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
